title: A Note on the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether Framework Applied to a Functional Equation (Putnam B4 Continuous f(x^2)=f(x)^2 Solution)

description:
Rigorous proof solving the continuous functional equation f(x^2) = f(x)^2 on [0, ∞) with f(0)=0, f(1)=1, and f(x) ≥ 0 via logarithmic conjugation g(t) = ln f(e^t), dyadic root iteration x^{1/2^k} → 1, and a symplectic tether damping functional E(k) = |g(t - k ln 2) - 2^{-k} g(t)|^2, establishing the unique power-law solution family f(x) = x^c (c > 0) and evaluating f(2)=4 ⇒ c=2, f(3)=9.
